get.summary: AuditLogs queries audit logs

parameters.name: pagination.key
parameters.description:
key is a value returned in PageResponse.next_key to begin
querying the next page most efficiently. Only one of offset or key
should be set.

parameters.name: pagination.offset
parameters.description:
offset is a numeric offset that can be used when key is unavailable.
It is less efficient than using key. Only one of offset or key should
be set.

parameters.name: pagination.limit
parameters.description:
limit is the total number of results to be returned in the result page.
If left empty it will default to a value to be set by each app.

parameters.name: pagination.countTotal
parameters.description:
count_total is set to true  to indicate that the result set should include
a count of the total number of items available for pagination in UIs.
count_total is only respected when offset is used. It is ignored when key
is set.

parameters.name: pagination.reverse
parameters.description: reverse is set to true if results are to be returned in the descending order.

AuditLog.title: AuditLog represents a comprehensive audit log entry

defaultTimelockDelaySeconds.title: Default time delay for time-locked actions (seconds)

AuthParams.title: AuthParams for role-based access control and sessions

maxRequestsPerWalletPerMonth.title: Maximum requests per wallet per month

keyRotationGracePeriodSeconds.title: Key rotation grace period (seconds) - old keys remain valid during this time

key.description:
key is a value returned in PageResponse.next_key to begin
querying the next page most efficiently. Only one of offset or key
should be set.

offset.description:
offset is a numeric offset that can be used when key is unavailable.
It is less efficient than using key. Only one of offset or key should
be set.

limit.description:
limit is the total number of results to be returned in the result page.
If left empty it will default to a value to be set by each app.

countTotal.description:
count_total is set to true  to indicate that the result set should include
a count of the total number of items available for pagination in UIs.
count_total is only respected when offset is used. It is ignored when key
is set.

reverse.description: reverse is set to true if results are to be returned in the descending order.

PageRequest.title:
PageRequest is to be embedded in gRPC request messages for efficient
pagination. Ex:

nextKey.description:
next_key is the key to be passed to PageRequest.key to
query the next page most efficiently. It will be empty if
there are no more results.

total.title:
total is total number of results available if PageRequest.count_total
was set, its value is undefined otherwise

RateLimitConfig.title: RateLimitConfig represents rate limiting configuration per user

roleName.title: Name of the role being assigned

RoleAssignment.title: RoleAssignment assigns a role to an address

ValidatorKeyRotation.title: ValidatorKeyRotation represents a key rotation event

v1beta1.EmergencyAdmin.title: EmergencyAdmin represents an emergency admin key with specific privileges

updatedAt.title: Timestamp when identity was last updated

verificationMethods.title: List of verification methods (public keys, not PII)

metadataHash.title: Metadata hash (hash of off-chain metadata, not the metadata itself)

piiCommitment.title:
Cryptographic commitment to PII data (SHA-256 hash)
Commitment = SHA256(sorted_attributes || salt)
This allows verification without storing raw PII on-chain

commitmentSalt.title:
Salt used in PII commitment (random 32 bytes)
Stored on-chain to allow verification but prevents rainbow table attacks

erased.title:
GDPR Right to Erasure flag
When true, PII has been erased but audit trail (commitment) remains

erasedAt.title: Timestamp when identity was erased (GDPR compliance)

offChainDataRef.title:
Off-chain data reference (IPFS CID, secure URL, or data location hint)
Actual PII stored here, not on-chain

offChainDataType.title: Off-chain data reference type (ipfs, https, did-document, etc.)

v1beta1.IdentityRecord.title:
IdentityRecord represents a decentralized identity
GDPR-compliant: stores only cryptographic commitments, not raw PII

v1beta1.MultisigProposal.title: MultisigProposal represents a proposal requiring multiple signatures

v1beta1.Params.title: Params defines unified identity module parameters

isSystemRole.title: Whether this is a system-defined role

updatedAt.title: Timestamp when role was last updated

v1beta1.Role.title: Role represents a named set of permissions

v1beta1.TimeLockedAction.title: TimeLockedAction represents an admin action with time delay
